methodology.priority_policy: Rank demand clusters using reported search volume, breadth of related queries, competition notes, and implementation feasibility.
methodology.volume_policy: Use only source-reported search volumes; rankings are directional and are not traffic forecasts.
methodology.existing_tool_policy: Do not generate a new tool when the current registry already provides the same core capability; route that demand to an enhancement instead.

queue.rationale: A focused utility with a reported 48K search-demand signal and low implementation complexity is a strong build.

Two source-reported US demand signals total 783K, while current competitors emphasize no-signup, no-watermark, privacy-first, styling, and export features. JunctionTools can differentiate with a simple browser-only static generator, no account, no server upload, and PNG download.

enhancements.rationale: The existing Image Compressor already covers the image-tool capability; capture image-resizing demand by extending that tool rather than generating a duplicate standalone tool.
